$comment: Maps GDD §6.3 class ids to existing sprite keys in CLASS_SPRITES (assets/sprites/class_sprites.html). Sprites that exist in CLASS_SPRITES but DO NOT match a GDD class are listed under 'orphanSprites' for triage. Empty 'spriteKey' means the sprite needs to be authored or an existing sprite repurposed.

knight.note: CLASS_SPRITES key 'Tank' renders as 'Knight' (display name in viewer)

warden.note: TODO: not in CLASS_SPRITES; consider repurposing 'Druid' palette or commission new

cleric.note: CLASS_SPRITES key 'Healer' = Cleric per GDD intent

templar.note: GDD places Templar as Healer; CLASS_SPRITES groups it under Divine — keep sprite, family per GDD

hunter.note: CLASS_SPRITES 'Beastmaster' = Hunter per GDD (beast companion). Also matches 'beastmaster' farlands class — see orphanSprites.

assassin.note: CLASS_SPRITES key 'Rogue' = Assassin per GDD intent

trickster.note: CLASS_SPRITES key 'Saboteur' fits Trickster's status-effect identity

bladestorm.note: CLASS_SPRITES 'Ninja' covers multi-hit AoE rogue silhouette

reaper.note: TODO: candidate base = 'Necromancer' palette adapted, but Reaper is Rogue family

arcanist.note: CLASS_SPRITES 'Mage' = Arcanist per GDD intent (pure burst caster)

beastmaster.note: TODO: 'Beastmaster' sprite key currently used for Hunter; needs rename or duplicate art for the farlands multi-pet class

voidcaller.note: CLASS_SPRITES 'Bloodmage' adapted (HP-cost dark magic vibe matches Voidcaller)

orphanSprites.$comment: Sprites that exist in CLASS_SPRITES but don't directly match a GDD class. Either repurpose, rename, or retire.
orphanSprites.Apothecary: scientific healer — no GDD slot; candidate for a future healer or merge with bloodpriest
orphanSprites.DeathKnight: no GDD slot; candidate for a wildcard or retire
orphanSprites.Valkyrie: no GDD slot; candidate for a wildcard or retire
orphanSprites.Dragoon: no GDD slot (lance/dragon-themed); candidate for fighter or marksman swap
